crossRefs.note: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that…
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…
who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might…
you shall not listen to the words of that prophet, or to that dreamer of dreams; for Yahweh your God is testing you, to…
The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…
Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be…

parallels.note: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…

translations.web: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
translations.bsb: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
translations.kjv: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
translations.asv: For thou, O God, hast proved us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
